metadata.title: Wahan Mosdeng | Pork with Chili Paste| Tripuri Recipe
metadata.description:
Tripura is a north-eastern state of India and the food culture amazing and vibrant. The cuisine is very attractive. Most of the dishes prepared are non-vegetarian like most of the Northeast India.

One of the popular pork dish is Wahan Mosdeng. To make the dish boil water in a pressure cooker with meat, salt, ginger and onion. Once the meat softens it is cut into small pieces added to fire grilled chili ground in to paste along with ginger and onion. Garnish the dish with coriander leaves.Serve this as a side to main course.
